"Build a premium portfolio showcase website for my Upwork profile. I am a web developer who builds custom web portals and apps for property management companies using PropertyMax.ai.

The live portal URL to link to is: marcreport-ypkstjhu.manus.space
My existing Google Sites portfolio (for reference only, do not copy the style): sites.google.com/view/brandonrosewebsites/home"
